Urbane Lounge, Black Angus Burger and Ms. Minh
May 2025 • Solo
This Urbane Lounge is so good with the Black Angus Burger. I am really sad because the restaurant cannot provide the medium rare option anymore. 😿Cry meow a river. 
But, one of the other factors that keep me going back is the very professional staff. Ms. Minh - Urban Lounge Agent, and Ms. Uyên who are friendly, down-to-earth and super attentive. If I am your Director of FnB, I will definitely promote the heaven out of you. Furthermore, I do want to add a small comment: Another two young men, who just quit the job and join their family business, my friend and my favorite staff here, Mr. Huy and Mr. Khoa from Room Service. Aiss sad sad sad.
Anyways, I will always be back for the warm welcomes and lovely Black Angus Burger.

Pullman Saigon Urbane Lounge
Feb 2020 • Friends
Me and my friends visited Pullman Saigon Urban Lounge and we had a very amazing experience there. We had 2 burger, 1 black angus burger and 1 customized miso bun burger, curly fries and a small salad.
The black angus was my favorite, the beef patty is juicy and flavorful, they paired it with cheddar cheese, bbq sauce, bacon and caramelized onion, it was amazing!
The customized one, we chose miso bun, crispy chicken, still the perfect combo bacon and caramelized onion, with gruyere cheese and teriyaki sauce. To be honest, this burger was lacking some flavor, I suppose it was because the wrong sauce pairing. The waitress suggested us chipotle sauce so we might try it when we come back.
The salad was just ok, we love the curly fries though, crunchy and very satisfying.
For me, it’s the best to have burger with coke or a glass of beer, Pullman also have cocktails and mocktails for you if you prefer!
